# CenturyLink of Minnesota

CenturyLink of Minnesota, Inc. is a telephone operating company providing local telephone services in Minnesota.
In 2005, Sprint Corporation acquired Nextel and changed its name to Sprint Nextel Corporation. In 2006, the company spun-off its local telephone operation into a separate company, Embarq Corporation. The company was renamed Embarq Minnesota, Inc.
Embarq was acquired by CenturyTel in 2009, which in 2010 changed its name to CenturyLink. Embarq Minnesota, at that point, began doing business under the CenturyLink name. The company's legal name was changed in 2022 to reflect its ownership by CenturyLink after most of Embarq was spun off to Brightspeed.
